info.title: Vero Web Trade - APIs Used By Frontend
info.description: OpenAPI export inferred from current frontend API calls in src/services, src/hooks/apps, src/app/api, and selected components. Some backend response payloads are documented as GenericObject where the frontend treats them dynamically. This version includes schema, field, request-body, response, and parameter descriptions. Fields marked as GenericObject or endpoint-specific data are dynamic in the current frontend code and should be refined with backend contracts when available.
